record.what_it_does: LiveAgent is a help desk and live chat platform for managing customer support tickets, chats, calls, and a knowledge base across multiple channels.
record.auth_notes: The core REST API (v1 and v3) is authenticated with a per-account API key sent in an 'apikey' request header, generated by an admin under Configuration > System > API. Separately, the official MCP server supports both a Bearer token (a personal access token generated in Edit profile > MCP Integration) and an OAuth 2.1 authorization-code flow with a consent screen for connecting third-party AI clients — OAuth2 would be the right choice for a multi-user agent toolkit built on the MCP layer, but the underlying REST API itself is API-key only.
record.access_notes: A permanent Free plan exists but explicitly excludes integrations/API access; full API access (and API testing) requires either a paid plan (Small/Medium/Large/Enterprise, from $10/agent/month annual) or the 30-day free trial, which gives full feature access with no credit card required.
record.main_blocker: API access gated behind paid plan or time-limited free trial (no permanent free API access)
